$$
\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {a}_{1} & {a}_{2} & {a}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}=\overset{Q}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ \frac{{v}_{1}}{‖{v}_{1}‖} & \frac{{v}_{2}}{‖{v}_{2}‖} & \frac{{v}_{3}}{‖{v}_{3}‖} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}\overset{R}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{r}_{11} & {r}_{12} & {r}_{13} \\ 0 & {r}_{22} & {r}_{23} \\ 0 & 0 & {r}_{33}\end{aligned}]}}
$$

Consider the QR factorization of the matrix $A$ shown above, where ${{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3}}$ is an orthogonal set of vectors. You're given that $‖{v}_{1}‖=4,$ $‖{v}_{2}‖=2,$ $‖{v}_{3}‖=6,$ and that the system of equations below describes the relationship between the columns of $Q$ and the columns of $A.$ 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{v}_{1}={a}_{1} \\ {v}_{2}={a}_{2}-2{v}_{1} \\ {v}_{3}={a}_{3}-4{v}_{1}+3{v}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

What is the value of ${r}_{11}+{r}_{13}+{r}_{33}?$

$$
\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {a}_{1} & {a}_{2} & {a}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}=\overset{Q}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {q}_{1} & {q}_{2} & {q}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}\overset{R}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{r}_{11} & {r}_{12} & {r}_{13} \\ 0 & {r}_{22} & {r}_{23} \\ 0 & 0 & {r}_{33}\end{aligned}]}}
$$

Consider the QR factorization of the matrix $A$ shown above. You're given that the system of equations given below connects the columns of $Q$ and the columns of $A.$  

$$
{\begin{aligned}{q}_{1}=\frac{1}{2}{a}_{1} \\ {q}_{2}=\frac{1}{4}{a}_{2}+2{q}_{1} \\ {q}_{3}=\frac{1}{6}{a}_{3}-4{q}_{1}+{q}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

What is the value of ${r}_{12}+{r}_{22}+{r}_{23}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's rewrite the vectors ${a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}$ as a linear combination of the vectors ${q}_{1},{q}_{2},{q}_{3}:$

$$
{\begin{aligned}{q}_{1}=\frac{1}{2}{a}_{1} \\ {q}_{2}=\frac{1}{4}{a}_{2}+2{q}_{1} \\ {q}_{3}=\frac{1}{6}{a}_{3}-4{q}_{1}+{q}_{2}\end{aligned}\,⟹\,{\begin{aligned}{a}_{1}=2{q}_{1} \\ {a}_{2}=-8{q}_{1}+4{q}_{2} \\ {a}_{3}=24{q}_{1}-6{q}_{2}+6{q}_{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, this system can be written in matrix form as follows:

$$
\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {a}_{1} & {a}_{2} & {a}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}=\overset{Q}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {q}_{1} & {q}_{2} & {q}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}\overset{R}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}2 & -8 & 24 \\ 0 & 4 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 6\end{aligned}]}}
$$

Therefore, 

$$
{r}_{12}+{r}_{22}+{r}_{23}=-8+4+(-6)=-10.
$$
